listings.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

listings.title: HBO/BACHELOR HRM STAGE
listings.description: Bufab Flos is op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige HR-stagiair(e) die ons team komt versterken. Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen diverse HR-werkzaamheden, jezelf te ontwikkelen én actief mee te draaien binnen de organisatie. Wie zijn wij? Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Wij zijn specialist in het leveren van bevestigingsmaterialen, technische componenten en logistieke diensten. Dat doen we niet zomaar: wij denken actief mee met onze klanten en adviseren bij technische vraagstukken. Of het nu gaat om A‑merk bevestigingsmaterialen, staal, RVS, gestandaardiseerde onderdelen, assemblages of maatwerk volgens klantspecificatie — wij regelen het volledig. Van sourcing en inkoop tot kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag en levering. In alles wat we doen staat één doel centraal: onze klanten maximaal ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en logistiek. Ons uitgangspunt is daarbij helder: afspraak is afspraak. Met 140 betrokken collega’s vormen we een divers en internationaal team. Bufab Flos maakt onderdeel uit van het Zweedse Bufab, maar is tegelijkertijd een toegankelijke organisatie waar samenwerken centraal staat. Onze medewerkers maken het verschil – en HR speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Om onze HR-afdeling te versterken én jou de kans te geven om ervaring op te doen, bieden wij een leerzame en veelzijdige meewerkstage op HBO/Bachelor-niveau aan. Wat ga je doen? Als HR-stagiair(e) draai je volledig mee binnen het HR-team en krijg een brede kijk op het HR-vak. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: 🔍 Ondersteunen bij werving- en selectie 🚀 Ondersteunen bij onboarding en offboarding 🗂️ Up-to-date houden van onze HR-systemen 🤝 Ondersteuning bij verzuimbegeleiding 💡 Meewerken aan HR-projecten zoals duur

listings.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
listings.description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms.
